fact_label: PPT/ETPV (Venezuelan temporary protection status) converts to permanent residency

notes: The single largest nationality-specific migration program of any candidate in this project, previously entirely unresearched in this file. After 5 years' continuous PPT (Permiso por Proteccion Temporal) possession, or 5 years combined PEP+PPT time, holders become eligible to apply for the Visa R under the ETPV -- a dedicated Resident-visa track for this population. PPT itself currently carries validity through 2031-05-30. Sourced to help.unhcr.org/colombia (directly quoting the statute's own conversion language: 'La tenencia ininterrumpida del PPT durante 5 anos habilita a los titulares para solicitar la Visa R para venezolanos bajo el ETPV'), cross-corroborated by independent legal-registry listings of Decreto 216 de 2021 (Funcion Publica's Gestor Normativo, SUIN-Juriscol, Refworld) agreeing on decree number/date/vigencia. A separate, narrower Visa V (Visitante Especial) track for pre-Dec-2024 arrivals is explicitly NON-renewable and NOT on this 5-year track -- do not conflate the two when reading this fact. || 2026-07-17 (pass 2): corroboration deepened -- UN Global Compact on Refugees ETPV good-practice page and UN Migration Network ETPV entry independently state the 10-year statute validity and the 5-year uninterrupted PPT -> Visa R eligibility. Confidence stays Medium: five distinct Colombian gov hosts blocked -- systematic access pattern; primary-text confirmation of the Visa-R article itself remains an open follow-up. || 2026-08-12 ([specialist], our records, post-transition retry): fresh retry of all 5 hosts post-08-07 inauguration -- 2 of 5 (icbf, migracioncolombia) now genuinely reachable at host level but yielded only scanned/image PDFs (no OCR tooling available this session); 3 of 5 (cancilleria, funcionpublica, dapre) still blocked, same failure modes as before, confirmed not transition-related. Wayback escalation unavailable (this session's fetch tool refuses web.archive.org outright). REAL CITATION CORRECTION found via search plus one primary-institutional partial fetch (Defensoria del Pueblo's legal-compilation mirror, forseti.defensoria.gov.co): Decreto 216 Art. 19 itself does NOT state the 5-year figure -- it defers the threshold to a later MRE administrative act. That act is Resolucion 5477 de 2022, Articulo 91 (R-ETPV category), NOT Resolucion 971 de 2021 as the file's structure previously implied. Four independent secondary sources (cedrizuela.com, affirmalegal.com, visasencolombia.com, lopezasociados.net) converge on this same Art. 91 attribution with direct quotes matching the 5-year continuous-or-accumulated PEP/PPT rule; Defensoria mirror confirmed the resolution's authenticity/structure but truncated before reaching Art. 91's own text. New mechanic found: R-ETPV visa requestable from 2023-06-01, PEP time countable from original PEP issuance date. Confidence deliberately held at Medium, not lifted to High -- better-corroborated and correctly-cited now, but still no verbatim primary-text read of Article 91 itself. Full writeup: visa-legal.md's 2026-08-12 update section.

fact_label: Digital Nomad Visa (Visa V) documentation shape
